sentences: The Northlight Library opens at 8 am and closes at 9 pm on weekdays.
On Saturdays the library opens at 9 am and closes at 6 pm.
The library is closed on Sundays and public holidays.
title: Opening hours

sentences: Printing costs ten cents per page for black and white pages.
Colour printing costs forty cents per page.
Members receive twenty free black and white pages every month.
title: Printing

sentences: The study rooms hold up to six people.
Study rooms can be booked for up to two hours per day.
A study room booking needs a library membership card.
title: Study rooms

sentences: Membership is free for city residents with photo identification.
Membership includes borrowing up to ten books at a time.
Members get free access to the computer lab on the second floor.
title: Membership

sentences: Members can borrow a book for three weeks.
A borrowed book can be renewed twice if nobody has reserved it.
Late returns cost fifty cents per day per book.
title: Loans

sentences: Story time for children runs every Saturday morning at ten.
Story time sessions last forty five minutes.
Parents stay with their children during story time.
title: Story time

sentences: The library wifi network is called Northlight Guest.
The wifi password changes every Monday and is posted at the front desk.
Wifi access is free for all visitors.
title: Wifi

sentences: Library cards expire after two years.
Card renewal is free at the front desk with photo identification.
An expired card cannot borrow books until it is renewed.
title: Card renewal

sentences: The library hosts a book club on the first Tuesday of every month.
Author talks take place in the main hall on Friday evenings.
Coding workshops for teenagers run on Wednesday afternoons.
title: Events

sentences: The library entrance has a wheelchair ramp and automatic doors.
Large print books are shelved on the ground floor near the entrance.
A hearing loop is fitted in the main hall for events.
title: Accessibility

sentences: Volunteers help shelve books for two hours each week.
Volunteer applications open in September and January.
Volunteers must be sixteen years or older.
title: Volunteering

sentences: Librarians offer free research help at the reference desk.
Research appointments last thirty minutes and can be booked online.
The reference collection includes local history archives and newspapers.
title: Research help
Yoga classes
sentences: The beginners yoga class starts at seven on Tuesday mornings in the hall.
Beginners yoga class lasts ninety minutes.
Yoga mats are stored in the hall cupboard.

title: Chess club
sentences: The chess club plays friendly games in the reading room on Friday evenings.
Chess club players gather on Friday evenings for registration.
Chess sets are kept in the games cupboard.

title: Pottery exhibition
sentences: The pottery exhibition opens to visitors on the first Saturday of March in the gallery hall.
Pottery exhibition visitors tickets are sold online.
Pottery classes meet in the basement studio.

title: Community garden
sentences: Priya Nair leads the community garden tour every Sunday morning.
Community garden tours need sturdy shoes on Sundays.
Garden tools are stored in the green shed.

title: Bicycles
sentences: Visitors park their bicycles in the rack beside the side entrance of the building.
Visitors who park bicycles must register at the front desk.
Bicycle racks are emptied every Sunday night.

title: Home delivery
sentences: The home delivery van visits members every Thursday afternoon with their books.
Home delivery van members register at the front desk.
Home delivery requests close at noon on Mondays.

title: French conversation
sentences: The French conversation group practices speaking every Wednesday evening at six.
French conversation group speaking notes are posted online.
French conversation textbooks sit on the second shelf.

title: Book repair
sentences: The book repair service charges ten dollars to fix a torn cover.
The torn cover book repair service is popular with readers.
Book repair glue dries overnight in the workshop.

title: Tai chi
sentences: The tai chi class meets in the rose garden every Monday morning at eight.
Tai chi class on Mondays is gentle and slow.
Tai chi students bring their own water bottles.

title: Seed library
sentences: A gardener borrows up to twenty seed packets from the seed library each spring.
Gardeners visit the seed library every spring.
Seed library donations are welcome in autumn.

title: Interlibrary loans
sentences: An interlibrary loan takes three weeks to arrive from another library branch.
An interlibrary loan can arrive late in winter.
Interlibrary loan fees are waived for members.

title: Movie club
sentences: The movie club screens the film Ocean Song this Friday evening.
Movie club film fans meet on Friday.
Movie club membership renews in January.
